prompts.P1_SHORT: Restore the printed word represented by PRIMARY OCR. Correct OCR mistakes, not writing style. Preserve correct text, names, numbers and punctuation. If scene context is supplied, it is only a fallible clue, never the answer to copy. If uncertain, copy PRIMARY OCR unchanged. Output only the final single word or code, without spaces, labels or explanations.
prompts.P2_RECONSTRUCT: You reconstruct text from an imperfect OCR observation of ONE crop. PRIMARY OCR may contain misread characters or a missing character. Recover the intended spelling when the observed characters and, if available, scene context support it. The task is transcription restoration, not scene description or answering a question. Do not append neighboring words or expand a fragment into a sentence. Preserve proper names, codes and punctuation. When several readings are plausible, keep PRIMARY OCR. Return one word or code only, without whitespace, quotation wrappers or explanations.
prompts.P3_CHARACTER_AUDIT: Check PRIMARY OCR character by character for OCR recognition errors. A change must repair an identifiable character substitution, insertion or deletion. Internally compare the proposed spelling with the original before answering; do not output your reasoning. Preserve punctuation, accents, dialect spellings, names, numbers and abbreviations unless there is evidence they were misread. Scene context, when supplied, cannot justify swapping to a different word. Leave plausible original readings unchanged. Output only the final one-word transcription, no whitespace or explanation.
prompts.P4_EVIDENCE_PRIORITY: Treat PRIMARY OCR as a noisy observation and WEAK SCENE CONTEXT, if present, as an unreliable description. Your goal is the text on this crop, not a word that merely fits the scene. Preserve the original when the description contradicts it, suggests another object, or does not identify a character-level correction. You may repair an OCR error supported by the observed spelling and context together. Never replace a correct name or code with a more familiar one. Return exactly one corrected word or code, or the original unchanged; no whitespace, labels or commentary.

go_rule: recovered>damaged AND exact>502 AND lexical_matches>=503 AND predicted_tokens<=1203; TRAIN diagnostic only

scientific_choices.choice: Four instruction variants fixed before GPU results; identical model, generation, examples, OCR and captions. Single-crop task only: do not interpret as multi-fragment reconstruction.

Reuse original conservative prompt as cached control with/without caption. Apply identical strict single-word output interpretation to all variants and controls; reject whitespace/empty/truncated output to original PARSeq, no edit-distance gate.

Reuse frozen five image-held-out fold demonstrations exactly, without reselection. TRAIN GT only in other-fold examples and post-hoc evaluation/logging. This prompt comparison is supervised in-context, not paper-faithful or independent validation.
Same qualified Qwen1.5B BF16 batch1 on PAPER; CPU-only checks in Codex. No installation, downloads, OCR, caption or segmentation inference.
A finite prompt study cannot prove all LLM methods fail. No automatic pipeline promotion; repeated TRAIN use can overfit prompt selection.
